training_data_source: ESA WorldCover v200 2021 used as ground-truth labels, remapped to 4 classes; Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (2023 median composite) used for feature bands. Sampled across 16 regions: Delhi_NCR_urban, Jaipur_urban_arid, Punjab_cropland, Thar_desert_bare, Chilika_lake_water, Western_Ghats_veg, Mumbai_dense_urban, Ganga_floodplain_mixed, Bangalore_urban, Chennai_coastal_urban, Sundarbans_water_mangrove, Rann_of_Kutch_bare_salt, Himalayan_foothill_veg, Godavari_delta_cropland, Rajasthan_bare_arid, Kerala_backwaters_water.
notes: Trained in Colab via train_model_colab.py using WorldCover-derived labels for traceability. v1 (RF, 8 features, 8 regions): 73.85% accuracy. v2 (RF, +B12/BSI/TEXTURE, 8 regions): 76.88%. v3 (RF, 16 regions, GridSearchCV tuning, class_weight='balanced'): 77.92% — doubling training data and tuning only bought ~1 point, signaling a Random-Forest ceiling on this feature set rather than a data-volume problem. v4 (this version): swapped RandomForestClassifier for XGBClassifier (gradient boosting), same data/features/split as v3, to see if a different algorithm could clear the ~78% ceiling.
